subject: Retry Framesmith using actual upstream MCP tool names
body: Execute immediately. Upstream Framesmith 2.0 names the render tool `screenshot`, not `canvas_screenshot`. Run create -> editorial structure -> screenshot -> modify same canvas -> screenshot -> canvas_evaluate. If another tool/schema mismatch occurs, record the exact tools/list and exact MCP error so the adapter can self-correct rather than repeating blindly. Do not touch Penpot.
